description.value: The Three Brits Public House is a beachfront pub overlooking English Bay in Vancouver's West End, its name rooted in the three English pioneers who settled the area in the mid-1800s. It offers both indoor and outdoor seating with bay views, weekend brunch, Thursday pub trivia, and late-night food. Part of the Freehouse Collective group, it occupies a prime spot near the seawall—one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors.
